instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem:
An adult is receiving electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) under general anesthesia. At 185 seconds after the stimulus, rhythmic motor activity continues in the isolated limb, and the EEG continues to show ictal activity. The anesthesia professional and ECT physician are at the bedside, and protocol orders for seizure termination are active. The client has not regained consciousness and has no new focal neurologic finding.

Complete the bowtie by selecting the most likely condition, the 2 priority actions, and the 2 parameters to monitor.
